questions.query: What hydraulic oil grade and temperature range are specified for the Series-4000 press?
questions.reference_answer: ISO VG 46 anti-wear hydraulic oil maintained between 38 C and 54 C.

questions.query: At what pressure does proportional relief valve PRV-402-B crack open and reach full bypass?
questions.reference_answer: PRV-402-B cracks open at 24.0 MPa and reaches full bypass flow at 25.2 MPa.

questions.query: What is the maximum allowable vacuum on suction manifold gauge VG-02 during cold startup?
questions.reference_answer: Vacuum at suction manifold gauge VG-02 must never exceed 17 kPa (5 inHg) during cold startup.

questions.query: What is the nominal coil resistance and minimum pull-in voltage for solenoid SOL-H88?
questions.reference_answer: Nominal coil resistance is 22.4 ohms at 20 C, and minimum pull-in voltage under load is 20.4 VDC.

questions.query: At what reservoir temperature does thermal switch TS-HIGH trip the pump motor?
questions.reference_answer: Thermal switch TS-HIGH triggers an automatic pump motor trip at 68 C, engaging latching relay K-9.

questions.query: What bevel angle and root opening are required for ASTM A572 Grade 50 single-V groove joints?
questions.reference_answer: Bevel angles of 30 degrees (+5/-0 degrees) and a root opening of 3.0 mm (+/- 0.8 mm).

questions.query: What temperature range must portable holding ovens maintain for E7018-H4R electrodes?
questions.reference_answer: Portable holding ovens must maintain E7018-H4R electrodes between 120 C and 150 C.

questions.query: What is the minimum preheat temperature for ASTM A572 Grade 50 plates over 38 mm thick?
questions.reference_answer: Minimum preheat temperature increases to 110 C for thicknesses exceeding 38 mm.

questions.query: What maximum oxygen concentration is allowed inside TP316L pipe bores before GTAW welding?
questions.reference_answer: Residual O2 concentration must be below 0.05% (500 ppm) before starting GTAW welding.

questions.query: How long must butt welds be held after cooling before ultrasonic testing under UT-SCAN-9?
questions.reference_answer: Welds must cool below 40 C and be held for 24 hours before UT-SCAN-9 inspection.

questions.query: What is the calculated incident energy and Arc Flash PPE Category for switchgear panel SWG-BUS-A?
questions.reference_answer: 14.8 cal/cm2 at 450 mm working distance, placing SWG-BUS-A in Arc Flash PPE Category 3.

questions.query: How often must CLASS-2-17KV rubber insulating gloves undergo laboratory electrical re-certification?
questions.reference_answer: Dielectric gloves must be re-certified every 6 months (withdrawn if >180 days from test date).

questions.query: What acetylene concentration in transformer TRF-5M indicates active internal arcing?
questions.reference_answer: Acetylene (C2H2) concentrations rising above 35 ppm signify active internal high-energy arcing.

questions.query: What is the float charge voltage and cell count for the substation 110 VDC battery bank?
questions.reference_answer: 55 lead-acid VRLA cells maintained at a float charge voltage of 124.85 VDC (+/- 0.5%).

questions.query: What torque must be applied to inter-cell copper busbars using insulated 1000 V wrenches?
questions.reference_answer: Torque wrenches must be set to 14 Nm on inter-cell copper busbars.

questions.query: What is the maximum allowable dissolved oxygen leaving deaerator DA-01 for boiler BLR-80T?
questions.reference_answer: Dissolved oxygen leaving DA-01 must remain strictly below 7 ppb (0.007 mg/L).

questions.query: What drum water pH and maximum silica limits apply at 4.2 MPa?
questions.reference_answer: Drum water pH must stay between 9.2 and 9.8, and total drum silica must remain below 2.5 ppm.

questions.query: What deposit weight density triggers chemical acid cleaning of boiler tubes?
questions.reference_answer: Acid cleaning is triggered when waterside deposit density exceeds 150 g/m2.

questions.query: At what drum level drop does LWCO-01 initiate a Master Fuel Trip?
questions.reference_answer: Dropping below -125 mm initiates an immediate Master Fuel Trip, closing DBB-1/2 within 1.2 seconds.

questions.query: What is the normal operating drum TDS limit controlled by continuous blowdown valve CBD-09?
questions.reference_answer: Drum total dissolved solids (TDS) are controlled below 800 ppm.

questions.query: What are the Safe Working Load ratings for main hoist MH-01 and auxiliary hoist AH-02?
questions.reference_answer: 25.0 metric tonnes on main hoist MH-01 and 5.0 metric tonnes on auxiliary hoist AH-02.

questions.query: What proof test load weight and hold duration are required for annual crane certification?
questions.reference_answer: A calibrated test weight of 31.25 tonnes (125% SWL) held for 10 minutes.

questions.query: What minimum wire diameter requires immediate discard of the 18 mm hoist wire rope?
questions.reference_answer: Outer wire diameter reduction exceeding 7% (measured below 16.74 mm) mandates replacement.

questions.query: At what wind speed does anemometer ANEM-01 automatically inhibit crane motion?
questions.reference_answer: At 20.0 m/s (72 km/h), crane motion is automatically inhibited.

questions.query: What heights below the trolley frame are limit switches HLS-01 and HLS-02 positioned?
questions.reference_answer: Primary switch HLS-01 is set 450 mm below the trolley frame and secondary HLS-02 at 200 mm.

questions.query: What steps must be taken before removing proportional directional valve PDV-118?
questions.reference_answer: Depressurize ACC-04 via NBV-03 three turns, confirm zero on PG-MAIN, flush 25 min, torque M10 bolts to 34 then 68 Nm.

questions.query: How should an operator torque the four M10 mounting bolts on valve PDV-118?
questions.reference_answer: Torque in a diagonal cross pattern in two stages: first stage 34 Nm, final stage 68 Nm.

questions.query: What is the recovery procedure after thermal switch TS-HIGH trips the hydraulic pump?
questions.reference_answer: Allow fluid to cool below 52 C, verify HEX-02 water flow >= 28 L/min, and press reset PB-RST-4.

questions.query: How do you manually lower the upper platen if power fails?
questions.reference_answer: Turn override screw OVR-77 clockwise using a 6 mm hex key while maintaining visual clearance.

questions.query: How should E7018-H4R electrodes be handled if exposed to >60% workshop humidity for 5 hours?
questions.reference_answer: Segregate and rebake once only at 370 C for 2.0 hours (or discard if flux is wet/flaking).

questions.query: What surface cleaning steps are required before tack welding ASTM A572 Grade 50 steel?
questions.reference_answer: Remove mill scale, grease, paint, and moisture within 50 mm of the weld toe via power brushing or grinding.

questions.query: What steps are required to repair a weld exhibiting slag inclusions longer than 12 mm?
questions.reference_answer: Full excavation, re-welding under repair spec WPS-REP-02, and 100% ultrasonic re-inspection.

questions.query: How should stainless steel pipe interiors be purged before GTAW root welding?
questions.reference_answer: Back-purge with argon using Purge Dam Kit PDK-60 until analyzer OA-900 reads below 0.05% O2.

questions.query: List the seven-step Zero Energy Verification sequence LOTO-77X for 11 kV switchgear.
questions.reference_answer: Notify operator, open downstream feeders, rack out VCB-11K, apply LOTO-PAD, Live-Dead-Live test with HV-DET-15KV, close ES-11K, attach PEC-04.

questions.query: What daily shift check is mandatory before wearing CLASS-2-17KV dielectric gloves?
questions.reference_answer: Perform a manual air-inflation roll test for pinholes/cracking and verify cuff tag GLV-STAMP is within 180 days.

questions.query: What diagnostic actions are required if transformer TRF-5M DGA shows >35 ppm acetylene?
questions.reference_answer: Take transformer offline and perform winding resistance and sweep frequency response analysis (SFRA-200).

questions.query: What test is triggered when a VRLA battery cell's impedance rises >25% above baseline?
questions.reference_answer: Conduct single-cell capacity discharge testing at C/10 rate (11 A).

questions.query: What is the exact opening and closing valve sequence for manual mud-drum blowdown?
questions.reference_answer: Open slow-closing BDV-12B first, open BDV-12A for 12 seconds, close BDV-12A first, then close BDV-12B last.

questions.query: How are boiler tubes passivated after hydrochloric acid cleaning?
questions.reference_answer: Neutralize with citric acid, passivate using sodium nitrite/ammonia at pH 9.5 for 6 hours, then hydrotest at 6.3 MPa.

questions.query: How is oxygen scavenged in the feedwater downstream of deaerator DA-01?
questions.reference_answer: Continuously meter catalyzed carbohydrazide solution SCAV-CHZ-10 to target 50-100 ppb residual at the economizer inlet.

questions.query: What daily shift check is mandatory for low-water level cutoff probes LWCO-01 and LWCO-02?
questions.reference_answer: Perform and log probe blowdown verification once per shift without bypassing LWCO-01.

questions.query: What actions must the crane operator take when sustained wind speed reaches 20.0 m/s?
questions.reference_answer: Move bridge to storm parking bay SP-01, engage rail clamps RC-A/B, and lower unloaded hook to 2.0 m above ground.

questions.query: What pre-shift test must be executed before lifting any payload with CRN-BAY3?
questions.reference_answer: Perform an unloaded functional bump test of upper hoist limit switch HLS-01.

questions.query: What is required to legally rig a load using sling angles below 30 degrees to the horizontal?
questions.reference_answer: Strictly prohibited without an engineered spreader beam SB-15T approved by the site rigging engineer.

questions.query: How is structural girder deflection evaluated during the annual 31.25-tonne crane proof test?
questions.reference_answer: Mid-span deflection must remain below L/800 (22.5 mm for the 18-meter span) with zero brake creep.

questions.query: Why would a hydraulic press make loud metallic banging noises and move jerkily?
questions.reference_answer: Pump cavitation caused by clogged strainer STR-14, collapsed hose HOSE-IN-09, low oil (<185 L), or air ingress via SSR-22.

questions.query: How do I release stored hydraulic energy safely before unbolting a control valve?
questions.reference_answer: Bleed accumulator ACC-04 by opening needle valve NBV-03 three turns until gauge PG-MAIN reads zero.

questions.query: My 24V directional actuator won't shift; what electrical resistance indicates a burnt-out or shorted coil?
questions.reference_answer: Below 18.0 ohms indicates an inter-turn short; above 30.0 ohms or infinite resistance indicates an open winding.

questions.query: What keeps the heavy upper press head from falling down if the electricity goes out?
questions.reference_answer: Counterbalance valve CBV-77 mechanically locks the upper platen during power loss.

questions.query: How do I keep stainless steel inside pipes from turning crusty and oxidized during TIG welding?
questions.reference_answer: Use argon back-purging below 0.05% O2 and keep torch argon flow between 14 and 18 L/min to avoid turbulence.

questions.query: Why can't we weld fast and hot without waiting between passes on thick structural steel?
questions.reference_answer: Exceeding 230 C interpass temperature degrades heat-affected zone Charpy impact toughness.

questions.query: What happens if low-hydrogen stick welding rods sit out on a humid workshop bench all day?
questions.reference_answer: Exposure over 4.0 hours above 60% RH requires single-time rebaking at 370 C for 2 hours or rejection if flux flakes.

questions.query: Why do inspectors wait a whole day after welding cools before running sound-wave flaw checks?
questions.reference_answer: The 24-hour hold accounts for the hydrogen-delayed cracking incubation period prior to UT-SCAN-9.

questions.query: Why are technicians banned from wearing polyester or nylon t-shirts under high-voltage flash suits?
questions.reference_answer: Synthetic fabrics like polyester and nylon can melt onto skin under arc-rated garments during an arc flash.

questions.query: How do electricians prove a high-voltage circuit is truly dead before touching busbars?
questions.reference_answer: Perform a Live-Dead-Live test using calibrated live-line tester HV-DET-15KV before closing the earthing switch.

questions.query: Which gas found in transformer oil tells us electrical sparks are jumping inside the tank?
questions.reference_answer: Acetylene (C2H2) above 35 ppm indicates active internal high-energy arcing.

questions.query: Why must we check the date inked on rubber electrical gloves even if they look clean?
questions.reference_answer: Dielectric gloves must be lab-recertified every 6 months; pairs >180 days past stamp must be withdrawn.

questions.query: What chemical damage occurs on steam turbine blades if boiler silica concentrations climb too high?
questions.reference_answer: Volatile silica carryover causes glass-like deposition on downstream steam turbine blades.

questions.query: Why do we open the slow blowdown valve before the fast valve, and close it last?
questions.reference_answer: Cycling BDV-12A inside open BDV-12B concentrates throttling and seat wear onto the outer sacrificial valve.

questions.query: How do engineers detect if cooling water is leaking into the pure steam condenser?
questions.reference_answer: Cation conductivity at sample point SS-03 spiking above 0.50 uS/cm indicates condenser tube leakage.

questions.query: What protective iron oxide layer are we trying to grow inside freshly acid-washed boiler tubes?
questions.reference_answer: Passivation with sodium nitrite/ammonia establishes a protective magnetite (Fe3O4) film.

questions.query: How much extra force hits each lifting sling leg when riggers lift with a shallow 30-degree bridle?
questions.reference_answer: At 30 degrees to horizontal, the tension multiplier doubles to 2.000, requiring spreader beam SB-15T.

questions.query: How many snapped strands or wires force us to throw away a crane hoist cable?
questions.reference_answer: 6+ broken wires in one lay (115 mm) or 3+ broken wires in a single strand within one lay.

questions.query: What keeps the crane hook from slamming upward into the overhead trolley drum?
questions.reference_answer: Primary rotary cam switch HLS-01 (450 mm below trolley) and secondary counterweight switch HLS-02 (200 mm below).

questions.query: When gusty weather starts picking up outside, at what speed do we get an early warning versus total shutdown?
questions.reference_answer: Amber warning beacon flashes at 15.0 m/s (54 km/h); automatic motion inhibit occurs at 20.0 m/s (72 km/h).

questions.query: What is the part specification and role of SSR-22?
questions.reference_answer: SSR-22 is the shaft seal ring inspected for air ingress during persistent cavitation.

questions.query: Explain the function of D-41 and PB-RST-4 in MAN-HYD-101.
questions.reference_answer: D-41 is the flyback suppression diode on SOL-H88 terminals; PB-RST-4 resets thermal trip relay K-9.

questions.query: Where is test port TP-01 used and what gauge accuracy is required?
questions.reference_answer: TP-01 is used to verify pressure with a Class-0.5 calibrated digital gauge before adjusting PRV-402-B.

questions.query: What is scrap bin BIN-RED-03 designated for in MAN-WLD-204?
questions.reference_answer: BIN-RED-03 receives rejected electrodes with wet or flaking flux coatings.

questions.query: What equipment is specified as TC-08 and OA-900?
questions.reference_answer: TC-08 is a calibrated contact thermocouple for preheat measurement; OA-900 is the oxygen analyzer for GTAW purging.

questions.query: What transducer frequency and angle are required by UT-SCAN-9?
questions.reference_answer: UT-SCAN-9 uses a 2.25 MHz, 60-degree shear-wave transducer.

questions.query: What are the model and rating of VRLA-110-AH cells?
questions.reference_answer: 55 lead-acid VRLA-110-AH cells with installation impedance baseline of 2.15 mOhm.

questions.query: What components are PEC-04 and DV-01 in MAN-ELE-309?
questions.reference_answer: PEC-04 is the portable earthing cluster attached in step 7 of LOTO-77X; DV-01 is transformer TRF-5M's DGA drain valve.

questions.query: What proof test voltage applies to CLASS-2-17KV gloves under ASTM D120?
questions.reference_answer: CLASS-2-17KV gloves are rated for 17,000 V AC max working voltage and tested at 20,000 V proof voltage.

questions.query: What chemical is dosed as SCAV-CHZ-10?
questions.reference_answer: SCAV-CHZ-10 is catalyzed carbohydrazide solution dosed into the deaerator storage drop-leg.

questions.query: What instruments are CT-401 and DPT-301?
questions.reference_answer: CT-401 is the conductivity transmitter modulating CBD-09; DPT-301 is the drum level differential pressure transmitter.

questions.query: What are DBB-1/2 and how quickly must they close on trip?
questions.reference_answer: DBB-1/2 are natural gas double-block-and-bleed valves closing within 1.2 seconds of a Master Fuel Trip.

questions.query: What is the wire rope construction and lay length of main hoist MH-01?
questions.reference_answer: 18 mm diameter 6x36 IWRC galvanized wire rope with a rope lay length of 115 mm.

questions.query: What are SP-01 and RC-A/B used for in MAN-CRN-520?
questions.reference_answer: SP-01 is the storm parking bay and RC-A/B are the rail clamps engaged during 20.0 m/s wind shutdown.

questions.query: When is spreader beam SB-15T required?
questions.reference_answer: SB-15T is required when rigging angles fall below 30 degrees to the horizontal.

questions.query: What pressure limit applies?
questions.reference_answer: Ambiguous across press (21.5 MPa working / 24.0 MPa relief) and boiler (4.2 MPa working / 6.3 MPa hydrotest).

questions.query: What is the required torque specification?
questions.reference_answer: Depends on component: PDV-118 valve bolts require 68 Nm; substation battery busbars require 14 Nm.

questions.query: How long should we wait before performing the inspection?
questions.reference_answer: Weld UT inspection requires a 24-hour delay; crane proof load test requires a 10-minute hold; glove lab recert is 6 months.

questions.query: What temperature threshold triggers a shutdown or trip?
questions.reference_answer: Hydraulic press thermal trip triggers at 68 C; welding maximum interpass is 230 C; transformer overheating flag at 500 C.

questions.query: What is the maximum allowed ppm limit?
questions.reference_answer: Depends on context: GTAW purge O2 <= 500 ppm; DGA C2H2 <= 35 ppm; drum silica <= 2.5 ppm; drum TDS <= 800 ppm.

questions.query: Which valve needs to be opened first?
questions.reference_answer: During mud-drum blowdown, open slow-closing BDV-12B first; for accumulator bleed, open NBV-03.

questions.query: What PPE is required for this task?
questions.reference_answer: Substation switchgear SWG-BUS-A mandates Category 3 (AR-25 suit, Class-2 shield, leather protectors).

questions.query: What is the voltage rating mentioned in the manual?
questions.reference_answer: Switchgear is 11 kV; dielectric gloves rated 17 kV; DC battery bank is 110 VDC (float 124.85 VDC); solenoid is 24 VDC.

questions.query: When do we replace the component?
questions.reference_answer: Hoist wire rope is discarded at 6+ broken wires in one lay or <16.74 mm diameter; gloves retired past 180 days.

questions.query: What flow rate should be checked?
questions.reference_answer: Heat exchanger HEX-02 water flow >= 28 L/min; GTAW shielding argon flow 14-18 L/min.
